This small plot is mine, and I will do it the way I know from before. I do not have money to buy fertilizer for such a small piece, and around here many of us with small root-crop plots use ash, manure, and crop waste instead. I will plant the local cuttings I kept and mix the plot with other crops, and I will rely on my own work and family work because hiring people costs too much.
